Name: Share Experience for Walk of life
Author: Meloki85
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Share overflowed experience from max-leveled skill to other skills.
Due to modder's skill, mod won't share experience to lvl 10 skills, you'll have to level them to lvl 11 by their own mechanics.
Other than that should be fine.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Just extract it to mod folder under SDV, (SMAPI is required)

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
You need Arleau's Walk of life and SMAPI for this mod to work.
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24355

Manifest.Name: ShareExperienceWOL
Manifest.Description: Share overflowed experience from max-level skills.(10/20)
Manifest.Author: Loki
